messages.subject: September 29 meeting: creating R packages
parts:
Brian Yandell will give a presentation on creating R packages on
Tuesday, September 29 at 2 p.m. I have reserved conference room 517
at 445 Henry Mall. Thanks, Brian, for agreeing to present our first
talk.

A reference on the subject: http://cran.r-project.org/doc/manuals/R-exts.pdf

Yury
